description: Measured duration of the mechanical T0 bootstrap (T10) on fresh empty repositories, with the v4.1.1 sequence: Conditor first, then the generator layered onto it. Wall-clock seconds on one host, each step timed separately. The steps a script cannot run without creating a real GitHub repository are not measured and are listed under notMeasured with the estimate the plan uses for them.

environment.network: github.com reachable through the session proxy; no credential set (GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN and CONDITOR_GITHUB_TOKEN unset)

tools.source: the release binaries the Registry set echelon-current pins for linux-x64 (channels/echelon-current/linux-x64.json), downloaded from their GitHub releases and checked against the pinned SHA-256; Conditor from its v0.10.18 release, checked against its checksums.txt
tools.generator: requirements-compiler v41 of this change, with --package requirements-compiled/v4.1.1

crossCheck: The same sequence, run with Praxis, Ordo and percepta-repo built from their release tags and Conditor from its source at 2d6ae48, took 71.8 s, 32.3 s and 75.9 s, with every step passing.

steps.name: 3-v411-bootstrap
steps.command: dotnet requirements-compiler.dll v41 --source INDY-INIT --package INDY-INIT/requirements-compiled/v4.1.1 --base INDY-INIT/requirements-compiled/v4 --check --bootstrap . | grep '^bootstrap:'

steps.name: 7-commit
steps.command: git add -A && git -c user.name=t0 -c user.email=t0@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m 'T0 bootstrap' && git ls-files | wc -l

runs.cache: warm Conditor cache (same cache as R1)

filesMergedOntoConditor: package.json (owner locks over Conditor pins; Conditor's name, type, scripts and dependencies kept)
filesKept: Directory.Build.props (Conditor's already sets every property the generator sets)

earlierFinding: An earlier measurement copied the v4.1 generator output over Conditor's repository. App.slnx then failed in 3 of 3 runs: NU1008 under the unconditional central package management, then NETSDK1013 with Conditor's Directory.Build.props overwritten. v4.1.1 fixes both: it layers instead of overwriting, and central package management applies only to Causa.* projects.

notMeasured.component: conditor repo create (publish, protect, GitHub Pages) and the first push
notMeasured.reason: needs a real GitHub repository; not created from this session

notMeasured.component: integration writes its remaining shared files: CI for Causa.slnx, playwright.config.ts, build.fsx, package-lock.json (npm install), web/boundary.js and the web entrypoint shells
notMeasured.reason: agent authoring, not a scripted step

notMeasured.component: first green CI on GitHub Actions
notMeasured.reason: needs a real GitHub repository and runner; GitHub Actions timings are not measured here

t10.measuredBasis: the slowest run, rounded up to whole minutes (R1-R3 at most 77 s; the script reproduction 83 s)
t10.note: The plan uses 29 minutes: 2 minutes measured and 27 minutes estimated. The estimated part is larger than the measured part, and the sensitivity scenarios in schedule.json cover it overrunning.

provenance: The three recorded runs (R1-R3) used an earlier shell runner that is not committed (this repository is F#-only, OD-INDY-14). tools/measure-t0-bootstrap.fsx was written afterwards to reproduce them with the same steps; its run is under reproduction.

reproduction.cache: cold Conditor cache, warm NuGet cache
reproduction.note: Every step passed; 83 s still rounds up to 2 minutes.
